title: Smoky Uruguayan Pilaf
description: A hearty, smoky pilaf dish inspired by Uruguay. Oozing cheese adds a rich, creamy texture.

ingredients.name: Oozing cheese
ingredients.notes: Choose a mild cheese like mozzarella or Monterey Jack

ingredients.name: Smoky
ingredients.notes: Adds a deep, smoky flavor to the dish

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until the onion is translucent.
Add rice, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat the rice in oil and spices.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in shredded cheese.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
